title: maven-lockfile tool contract
description: The fields of a lockfile that other tools, such as dependency update bots, may rely on. They keep these paths and types in every lockFileVersion. Everything else in the lockfile may change between releases, so this schema does not describe it.

lockFileVersion.description: The format version of the file. A release rejects a version newer than it can read.

mavenLockfileVersion.description: The maven-lockfile release that generated the file. Regenerate with this release or a newer one: an older release may not read the file, and validate fails on its different plugin checksum.

hermetic.description: Whether the file holds artifacts resolved during a real build. A tool that only runs generate cannot reproduce them, so it must not regenerate such a file.
